'''2013 Match Play Championship Day 1 Sam Marlow LS Coruscant: Night Club''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Sam Marlow]] at [[2013 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Coruscant: Night Club (Virtual Block 5)|VB5-L-coruscantnightclub-pre.gif|label=Coruscant: Night Club}}
* '''Username:''' Hari Seldon
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
